systemManage.casdoor.acceptUntil: Accept until (UTC, ISO 8601 ending in Z)
systemManage.casdoor.applicationHelp: Use a dedicated organization application created by its administrator, not DCR or built-in/global-admin. Deployment provenance must be verified separately.
systemManage.casdoor.callbackHelp: Reference from the explicitly configured deployment Console API base. The callback is unavailable until sign-in is implemented and verified; this is not a working sign-in link.
systemManage.casdoor.callbackUnavailable: No trusted absolute Console API base was configured for this deployment.
systemManage.casdoor.certificateHelp: At most two public certificates. Set UTC acceptance windows for an explicit rotation overlap. Unknown signatures remain rejected.
systemManage.casdoor.clearHelp: This creates a new draft revision without its Secret. The active revision is unchanged. It does not apply to unsaved fields.
systemManage.casdoor.cleared: The saved draft Secret was cleared.
systemManage.casdoor.conflict: The request could not be confirmed against the current server revision. Refresh and explicitly re-edit before saving again.
systemManage.casdoor.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the reference manually.
systemManage.casdoor.description: Save an immutable draft. Saving and static checks do not enable SSO or change current sign-in.
systemManage.casdoor.dirty: Unsaved changes. Static checks and Secret clearing operate only on saved drafts; save or explicitly re-edit first.
systemManage.casdoor.earliestAmbiguous: The earliest creation time is tied. Stable ID ordering does not prove which workspace came first.
systemManage.casdoor.fallback: When the full effective role set is known but no default-workspace mapping matches, join the default workspace as normal. Unknown roles or unavailable workspaces fail closed.
systemManage.casdoor.invalidCertificate: Use public X.509 PEM only, unique kid values, and an increasing UTC window ending in Z.
systemManage.casdoor.invalidMapping: Use a unique workspace and exact organization/role pair in each occupied slot. A role may occupy only one slot per workspace.
systemManage.casdoor.invalidUrl: Enter an HTTP(S) URL with a host and no credentials or fragment. HTTP exceptions require deployment approval.
systemManage.casdoor.loadFailed: Casdoor configuration could not be loaded.
systemManage.casdoor.mappingHelp: Enter exact RoleRef organization and name; no roles API is available yet. Each workspace has one admin, editor and normal slot. Multiple matches use admin > editor > normal. Owner is excluded; existing unmanaged permissions remain protected.
systemManage.casdoor.notBefore: Valid from (UTC, ISO 8601 ending in Z)
systemManage.casdoor.optionalUnavailable: RP logout and self-unlink remain off until their capabilities and runtime behavior are independently verified.
systemManage.casdoor.profileHelp: Managed mode does not take ownership of existing non-empty local values. Avatar mode is independent of name mode. Email differences do not overwrite the local email.
systemManage.casdoor.reeditHelp: This replaces the current edits with the latest loaded server draft and clears transient Secret input. Refresh server state first to load a newer revision.
systemManage.casdoor.requestFailed: The request failed. Only a safe error code and correlation ID are shown.
systemManage.casdoor.saved: Draft saved. SSO activation has not changed.
systemManage.casdoor.secretConfigured: A Secret is configured for the saved draft.
systemManage.casdoor.secretHelp: Never displayed. Leave blank to keep the server draft Secret. Clear is a separate confirmed action.
systemManage.casdoor.secretMissing: The saved draft has no Secret.
systemManage.casdoor.secretReset: The transient Secret input has been cleared. Re-enter it if retrying a replacement.
systemManage.casdoor.stale: A newer server revision is available. Your edits are retained; saving requires an explicit refresh and re-edit.
systemManage.casdoor.staticExpired: The displayed static result belongs to an earlier server revision. Run static checks again on the current saved draft.
systemManage.casdoor.staticPassed: Static checks passed for revision {{id}} / ETag {{etag}} at {{time}}. This is not protocol, diagnostic, deployment or SSO activation proof.

systemManage.casdoor.workspaceHistory: For this development deployment, select the earliest-created workspace under the confirmed rule and save its fixed UUID. Resolve ties or missing records before selecting. List order and the current workspace cannot replace creation time.
systemManage.casdoor.workspaceOffPage: Selected UUID is outside the current page; this does not mean it is unavailable.

systemManage.casdoor.disableHelp: This immediately blocks new Casdoor sign-ins. Remote role or resource operations may still need reconciliation.
